About A R Rajah Mohaideen & his Preparation Journey
A R Rajah Mohaideen was born in Chengalpattu but a resident of Nandanam, Chennai .
His academic achievements in early years were impeccable with a CGPA of 10 in Class-X & 95.58% in Class-XII at DAV School.
Remembering his initial two attempts when the result wasn't in his favour in the Prelims, he improved his preparation strategy.

With Anthropology as an optional subject and focussing on practicing many test series, A R Rajah Mohaideen turned his medical career into a successful civil services career, achieving AIR 7 in UPSC CSE 2025 in his 3rd attempt .

During the journey of UPSC Preparation, A R Rajah Mohaideen (AIR-7 UPSC CSE 2025) took the coaching for the current affairs course (CA-VA) from NEXT IAS.

Current Affairs plays a significant role in the preparation of the UPSC Civil Services exam, be it prelims, mains or interview. In the Prelims Exam, on average, 30-35 questions are asked directly based on current affairs. The applied weightage of current affairs is significantly higher in the mains because answers are to be written analytically with a static cum current approach. Similarly, knowledge of current issues is equally crucial for the final stage i.e Personality Test or Interview.
